name: dev
description: Everyday development skills for Claude Code: pick up an issue, file one, research a question, commit and push, open a PR, babysit it to merge, merge the base and fix conflicts, find out why CI is red, recap where the work stands, list the PRs that need you, write your standup, answer questions about the git history, write a release's notes and check its crashes, test the app on real phones and say which phones a PR was tested on, review a PR end to end through parallel Codex runs, hand sub-tasks to Codex or to a Claude worker agent, build claude.ai Artifacts in an agent of their own, free disk space safely, and stop a runaway agent command before it eats all the memory.
